title: Color analysis in Bend: price, swatches and the upstairs studio
seoTitle: Bend Color Analysis: Full Cost, Swatches and Studio Access
description: Read the Bend service listing beyond its introductory fee: digital and physical palettes, daylight, upstairs access and a self-guided app alternative.
excerpt: The introductory US$195 listing at Styled by Sarah Richards is only part of the decision. Physical swatches, appointment light and access to Salon June deserve their own lines on your planning sheet.

sections.title: Check the introductory fee and physical-swatch extras
sections.html:
For color analysis in Bend, the useful comparison is the complete visit and what you take home. An introductory fee can be attractive, but a digital result, a physical wallet and a makeup lesson are not interchangeable. Check the current rate and the appointment setting before you build a shopping budget around an older quote.

Styled by Sarah Richards

The Bend service page lists an introductory US$195 consultation lasting up to two hours at Salon June. It describes natural-daylight draping, a digital palette and guidance for hair and makeup. Physical swatch cards or books are available to buy separately. The studio is upstairs with one flight of stairs.

View the provider’s service information ↗

sections.title: Three details to settle before paying a deposit
sections.html:
Ask whether the appointment time leaves enough daylight for the provider’s process, what preparation is expected, and how much an optional physical palette costs. If stairs are a problem, discuss access before paying a deposit. Bring a photo of the jacket or outfit that prompted the booking, so the consultation can connect the palette to a real decision.

  • Is the introductory rate still available for my date?
  • What is the total with a physical palette, and is the studio accessible to me?

sections.title: Test the palette on a layer you already own
sections.html: Afterwards, choose one everyday layer and one accent to test together. Outdoorsy clothes, office clothes and evening clothes can all use the same color relationship without needing the same fabric or formality. The app is useful for keeping that idea available on your phone; a physical swatch is useful when examining the actual garment. Compare in even light rather than treating a retail display spotlight as a reliable reference.

sections.title: Do you need fabric in your hand or ideas on your phone?
sections.html:
A physical swatch can travel from the consultation into a fabric comparison; an app screen cannot replace the material’s texture or finish. That makes the optional wallet a more relevant extra for some people than a long list of new clothes. Ask to see the wallet before deciding whether to buy it.

Stylist AI offers a separate route: choose your interests in the introduction, add a clear selfie, then explore a palette, outfit combinations and makeup or hair previews. You can revisit those tools without arranging studio access. Use the camera color check to consider an existing layer, while judging the actual fabric yourself. Premium features are offered through in-app purchases, so compare the current plan with the complete studio quote.
